name: SeaTac Packaging Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: SeaTac Packaging is an independently owned and professionally operated manufacturing company located in the Greater Seattle area. Founded in 1994, SeaTac Packaging designs, manufactures, and delivers a wide variety of multiwall, PaperWoven™, and flexible packaging. Made in Washington, from our roots serving the seafood industry, SeaTac Packaging has organically grown to be a valued partner for small businesses to Fortune 500 companies by focusing on quality and service at a competitive price. Scroll down to learn more!
about:
SeaTac Packaging Manufacturing Corporation operates from Puyallup, Washington, in the Greater Seattle area. The company was founded in 1994 by Scott, who identified an opportunity to better serve the Pacific Northwest fishing community with an innovative PaperWoven™ product. Starting with three employees, one bag line, and one printing press, the independently owned business set out to become the preferred supplier for seafood processors.

Today, SeaTac designs, manufactures, and delivers a range of multiwall, PaperWoven™, and flexible packaging solutions. Its capabilities span flexographic printing up to ten colors using water-based inks, coating and laminating with structures such as polypropylene, high-density polyethylene, and biaxially oriented polyamide, as well as graphic design, product development, and converting. The company runs multiple bag lines and what it describes as the widest-web, longest-repeat sustainable water-based press in the western United States, supported by large modern warehouses with 30-foot clear heights and high-bay racking for vendor-managed inventory programs.

SeaTac serves industries including food and ingredient packaging (flour, rice, evaporated dairy, potatoes, spices), agricultural products (seed, beans, peas, lentils), chemical products, and its original fishing and seafood sector. Its customer base ranges from small businesses to Fortune 500 companies, with the company emphasizing a local touch backed by a global network.

The firm differentiates itself as a vertically integrated, MBE-certified manufacturer—the only U.S. polyethylene woven producer with that designation, according to its leadership. All bags are made in America at facilities compliant with FSMA and FDA regulations and audited to the GFSI IFS PACsecure higher-level standard. A lean, just-in-time philosophy underpins what the company calls industry-leading lead times, while an in-house lab and third-party testing partners support quality assurance and food safety commitments.
